notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental funds statement (p3 Total Governmental Funds column) used for receipts/disbursements; all funds including School Nutrition and Activities are governmental. Beginning balance 10,599,254 is the printed beginning fund balance (cash basis, equals total assets); ending 12,063,923 equals total assets (cash 3,161,464 + CDs 8,234,000 + county treasurer 668,459). Transfers of 110,000 (General to Nutrition 70,000 and Activities 40,000) net to zero in the total column; recorded gross in transfers_in/out. Balance sheet from the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p2): no liabilities. Detail: budget-and-actual schedules by fund (pp9-20); General Fund combining schedule (pp6-7) and nonmajor combining schedule (p8) not recorded in detail to avoid double counting except the General Fund Reclassifications column, which is used for hidden-transfer contra lines. General Fund spending lines are at program-code level without object breakdown (not itemized); header-level budgets (Support services - students 160,500, instruction 193,300, central 183,900, plant 573,800) not entered. State and federal program spending counted under Instruction (statement p6 lists them as separate programs reclassified into functions). General Fund budget schedule total disbursements 5,537,808 include 110,000 of transfers and 370,590 hidden transfers recorded as other financing. Zero/blank actual lines (Special Building capital outlay, Employee Benefit benefits paid, Cooperative Fund, Student Fee activity fees) are not recorded. Read pages 1-20 of 20
